dialogues.en: Keep the jokes in your own dream......
dialogues.text: Keep the jokes in your own dream......

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あいたッ！　なにするんだよぉ！？」
dialogues.en: "Ouch! What are you doing!?"
dialogues.text: "Ouch! What are you doing!?"

dialogues.jp: でこぴんを｛いっせん／一閃｝して、へへへ、と笑う。
dialogues.en: I flicked on her forehead and smiled.
dialogues.text: I flicked on her forehead and smiled.

dialogues.jp: 「冗談は夢のなかだけにしろ」
dialogues.en: "Keep the joke in your dreams."
dialogues.text: "Keep the joke in your dreams."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ぶぅ」
dialogues.en: "Boo."
dialogues.text: "Boo."

dialogues.jp:
おでこをさすりながら、さくらが冗談めかして
頬をふくらませる。
dialogues.en:
Sakura puffed her cheeks jokingly, and rubbed on her
forehead.
dialogues.text:
Sakura puffed her cheeks jokingly, and rubbed on her
forehead.

dialogues.jp: 「そんなこ――」
dialogues.en: "You better ---"
dialogues.text: "You better ---"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ただいま兄さん。なんか変な胸騒ぎが――」
dialogues.en: "Hey, I'm home. I just had this uneasiness---"
dialogues.text: "Hey, I'm home. I just had this uneasiness---"

dialogues.jp:
ノックもなく扉を開けた音夢が、机に身をのり
だしたさくらを見て言葉を切る。
dialogues.en:
Nemu stopped talking as she saw Sakura leaning on the desk
when she opened the door without a knocking.
dialogues.text:
Nemu stopped talking as she saw Sakura leaning on the desk
when she opened the door without a knocking.

dialogues.jp: 「よぉ、音夢」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Nemu."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Nemu."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「おかえり〜」
dialogues.en: "You're back."
dialogues.text: "You're back."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、うん」
dialogues.en: "Huh, yeah."
dialogues.text: "Huh, yeah."

dialogues.jp:
胸を押さえて、音夢が奇妙な表情を浮かべてう
つむいてしまう。
dialogues.en:
Nemu had a strange expression on her face, and looked down
with her hand pressing the chest.
dialogues.text:
Nemu had a strange expression on her face, and looked down
with her hand pressing the chest.

dialogues.jp: 「どこか痛いのか？」
dialogues.en: "Is there anything wrong?"
dialogues.text: "Is there anything wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ううん……なんでもないの。大丈夫だよ私は」
dialogues.en: "No...... Nothing's wrong. I'm fine."
dialogues.text: "No...... Nothing's wrong. I'm fine."

dialogues.jp: えい、っと腕を曲げる。
dialogues.en: She bends her arms to make a pose.
dialogues.text: She bends her arms to make a pose.

dialogues.jp: 「ホントか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you sure?"
dialogues.text: "Are you sure?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「うん。それじゃあ制服着替えてくるから。ゆっ
　くりしてってね、さくら」
dialogues.en: "Yeah. I'm going to change. Make yourself at home, Sakura."
dialogues.text: "Yeah. I'm going to change. Make yourself at home, Sakura."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あ〜、うん……でも、そろそろ帰るよ」
dialogues.en: "Oh, yeah...... But, I should be leaving."
dialogues.text: "Oh, yeah...... But, I should be leaving."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「そう？　あ、でも、帰りはちゃんと玄関から
　出ていってよ。靴がなくてびっくりしたんだ
　から」
dialogues.en:
"Oh? But make sure you go out through the front door. You
surprised me because I didn't see your shoes at the door."
dialogues.text:
"Oh? But make sure you go out through the front door. You
surprised me because I didn't see your shoes at the door."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うん。じゃあ、ボク帰る。うたまるの散歩に
　行かなきゃ」
dialogues.en: "Okay. I'm going now. I have to take Utamaru for a walk."
dialogues.text: "Okay. I'm going now. I have to take Utamaru for a walk."

dialogues.jp:
とてとて、と窓辺に寄ってさくらが白猫を頭に
のせる。
dialogues.en:
Sakura walked to the window and placed the white cat on her
head.
dialogues.text:
Sakura walked to the window and placed the white cat on her
head.

dialogues.jp: 「なぁ、そいつ自力で歩かせてくれ」
dialogues.en: "Hey, make her walk by herself."
dialogues.text: "Hey, make her walk by herself."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うにゃ。駄目だよぉ。素足だから床が汚れちゃ
　うもん」
dialogues.en:
"Huh? No. She'll make the floor dirty because she's
barefooted."
dialogues.text:
"Huh? No. She'll make the floor dirty because she's
barefooted."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Foot? ......foot."
dialogues.text: "Foot? ......foot."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「それじゃね。ふたり共、暇なときはウチにも
　遊びに来てね」
dialogues.en: "Well, then. Come visit when you have time, you two."
dialogues.text: "Well, then. Come visit when you have time, you two."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「おぅ」
dialogues.en: "Right."
dialogues.text: "Right."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ごめんね。音夢ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, Nemu-chan."
dialogues.text: "Sorry, Nemu-chan."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ううん」
dialogues.en: "No problem."
dialogues.text: "No problem."

dialogues.jp:
ふたりで笑いあった後、軽い足音でさくらが扉
の外に消えた。
dialogues.en:
Sakura disappeared out the door after they smiled at each
other.
dialogues.text:
Sakura disappeared out the door after they smiled at each
other.

dialogues.en: "Sigh."
dialogues.text: "Sigh."

dialogues.jp:
「なんだかなぁ。学園じゃないってのに、人が
　忙しく出入りしてるし……」
dialogues.en:
"What's this? People are just coming in and out even when we
aren't at school."
dialogues.text:
"What's this? People are just coming in and out even when we
aren't at school."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「お疲れ兄さん？」
dialogues.en: "Are you tired?"
dialogues.text: "Are you tired?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「かったりぃ」
dialogues.en: "Such a pain."
dialogues.text: "Such a pain."

dialogues.jp: ベッドに腰をおろして、片手を広げる。
dialogues.en: I sat on a bed and opened my arm.
dialogues.text: I sat on a bed and opened my arm.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあさ、どうせ夕食の買い物に行くんだし、
　私着替えるのめんどうだから今行こう♪」
dialogues.en:
"So then, let's go out. We have to go get dinner anyways,
and I don't feel like changing my clothes, so let's go right
now."
dialogues.text:
"So then, let's go out. We have to go get dinner anyways,
and I don't feel like changing my clothes, so let's go right
now."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……人の話聞いてるのかお前？」
dialogues.en: "......Are you listening to what I'm saying?"
dialogues.text: "......Are you listening to what I'm saying?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「気分転換よ。外、気持ちいいんだから♪」
dialogues.en: "You'll feel better. It's really nice outside."
dialogues.text: "You'll feel better. It's really nice outside."

dialogues.jp:
ふわりとスカートを翻して、音夢が小さく微笑
んで俺に手を差し出す。
dialogues.en:
Nemu smiled a little and reached her hand out to me as she
flares her skirt.
dialogues.text:
Nemu smiled a little and reached her hand out to me as she
flares her skirt.

dialogues.jp: 「……面倒だな」
dialogues.en: "......What a pain."
dialogues.text: "......What a pain."

dialogues.jp:
言葉とは裏腹に俺は唇を歪めて、その手をとっ
た。
dialogues.en: Despite what I said, I was smiling as I took her hand.
dialogues.text: Despite what I said, I was smiling as I took her hand.

dialogues.jp: ◆冗談は夢のなか◆
dialogues.en: ◆Leave the jokes in the dream◆
dialogues.text: ◆Leave the jokes in the dream◆

dialogues.jp:
身を乗り出すさくらに、でこぴんを｛いっせん／一閃｝してや
る。冗談は夢の中だけでしろっての……。
dialogues.en: I flicked Sakura's forehead as she leaned forward to me.
dialogues.text: I flicked Sakura's forehead as she leaned forward to me.
